chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from him, عليه السلام, that he said:

There is no servant who performs salat in its time and finishes, then comes to them and performs salat with them while he is in a state of wudu (ablution), except that Allah writes for him twenty-five degrees.

key_terms.خَمْساً وَ عِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً: twenty-five درجات, meaning levels or ranks of reward
key_terms.عَلَى وُضُوءٍ: while in a state of wudu (ablution)
key_terms.فِي الْوَقْتِ: within the prescribed time of salat
key_terms.مَعَهُمْ: with them, meaning together with the group

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for praying again with the congregation after already praying on time?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the merit of repeating salat with a group after having already performed it on time, provided one remains in a state of wudu (ablution). It highlights the great reward of joining congregational worship and strengthening communal devotion.
